name: tabpfn-rust
description: A port of TabPFN to Rust with bindings in Python and WASM

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p tabpfn-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tabpfn_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg --target web --no-typescript
scripts.bench:all: npm run fixtures && npm run bench && npm run analyze
scripts.smoke: bun run scripts/harness_wasm.ts --dataset clf_iris_s --reps 3 --mode cached --out scripts/results/tmp/smoke.json
